scope: Bounded read-only preparation review of the new repeat wrapper and its current prepared package/driver integration. Not a review of original experimental raw or results.

checks.name: four_cell_ABBA_manifest
checks.detail: The immutable parent manifest is filtered by native/most_output, preserving native -> most_output -> most_output -> native. Exact manifest equality and launcher label equality require precisely four cells.

checks.name: unchanged_parent_runtime_inputs_and_warmups
checks.detail: Read-only byte/hash inspection found all 21 listed runtime/input/source files identical to the frozen parent and receipt. The archive contains 24 files and every archived file equals preparation/source. Only campaign.json and DECISIONS.md differ from parent; parent_campaign.json is added.

checks.name: no_legacy_eight_cell_result_gate
checks.detail: Eight-cell validation is applied only to parent provenance in prepare/validate. The new analyze path iterates the four-cell manifest and never calls the old eight-cell analyze function. It calls recovery.cell directly with campaign=True, without invoking the older campaign_layout gate.

checks.name: all_four_and_common_resource_gate_before_numeric_pairs
checks.detail: Every cell must be complete, identity/accounting/action qualified, and share engine_args plus config excluding only completion_policy/rotation_victim_order. Cap remains in the common signature. Underlying cell checks pin cap 32, physical KV 16089350144 bytes, usable blocks 7671 and token budget 1024. compare receives common=False until all four qualify; it returns before numeric comparison. Two within-block native/most pairs and two same-role repeats are the only pairs.

checks.name: current_driver_and_fresh_engine_compatibility
checks.detail: Provided stage/resume commands pass explicit four labels. Current driver validates their order against archive campaign, iterates args.labels, launches the unchanged one-cell entrypoint and reads each result before the next. Each cell spawns a fresh run_probe subprocess. Resume requires untouched STAGED state, matching source/host/GPU/archive and empty results; it cannot silently relaunch a started cell.

checks.name: unique_source_and_output_selection
checks.detail: Preparation and analysis refuse an existing output directory. Analysis selects run/frozen when present, otherwise only its sibling preparation/source. New run and remote directories are specific to 20260914_rotation_runtime_repeat_r01, distinct from parent results; driver validates stage/resume identity and frozen archive contents. No old result-directory glob or canonical selection is introduced.

checks.name: existing_UNRUN_result_readback_only
checks.detail: The already generated result records four UNRUN cells, comparisons_eligible=false, common_execution_config=false, no recovery accounting and no numerical pairs. Reviewer read this result without rerunning the analyzer or adding tests.

limitations: Code-only review does not assert that any new GPU cell ran or passed.
No new test suite, synthetic fixture, GPU command, SSH call, old raw analysis, or source mutation was performed.
Only this bounded_review.json was written by the reviewer.
